seo.title: About Desh Bhakt
seo.description: Who we are, what we believe and why we think patriotism is best shown through everyday duty.

blocks.heading: About Desh Bhakt
blocks.sub: A citizens' initiative to make love for the country visible in what we do, not only what we say.

blocks.markdown:
## Our belief

India's freedom was won by ordinary people who gave their time, comfort and sometimes their lives. We honour them best by **keeping the promise of the Constitution alive** in our own lives.

Desh Bhakt is open to everyone, of every faith, language and region. We do not support or oppose any political party.

cards.title: Unity
cards.text: Diversity is our strength. We speak in every language and welcome every community.
